patch_description: This design keeps direct-demand rewards but changes the two-hop signal to favor routes through relays and links with more estimated spare capacity. Relay pressure blends mean-normalized and max-normalized estimates, with a floor so a busy node is discouraged rather than ruled out. Candidate paths are ranked using both relay pressure and the direct-demand burden on their component links; a capped reward is then shared among the best candidates for each OD pair. This combines the earlier programs’ direct-service and two-hop ideas while making route selection explicitly congestion-aware.
